title: Free versions of the strong Szegő limit theorem
summary: The Strong Szegő Limit Theorem is a theorem about the asymptotics of the determinants of large Toeplitz matrices. It can be reformulated as a probabilistic statement about eigenvalue statistics of random unitary matrices. We prove a multivariate generalization of the theorem in this latter form, replacing a single unitary with a system of independent random unitaries. It turns out that the standard proofs of the classical theorem do not generalize to this setting, and instead we must import tools from random matrix theory, free probability, and noncommutative function theory.
